ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centralized low-intensity black pigmentation extending from the peduncle attachment point into a wide butterfly-shaped pattern, transitioning to high-intensity white regions on the lateral lobes. Distal tips exhibit concentrated low-intensity clusters.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped depression with an estimated aperture of 85-95 degrees and moderate depth relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary, with more pronounced irregular peaks observed on the distal halves of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to dorsally-oriented, slightly tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly textured, low-intensity pixel clusters localized at the far distal tips of both lobes, indicating significant localized surface disruption.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two prominent, mirrored low-intensity linear marks (rake marks) slicing diagonally across the white sections of the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Symmetrical diagonal rake marks and heavily textured distal margins consistent with historic physical interactions and epibiont colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: A series of small, isolated black spots (mottling) punctuating the white field near the transition boundary of the central black pigment.
